paragraphs.text:
The corporal is friendly, but nervous. You can tell that he is 
unconvinced by the death report. Something scares him, but he 
only mutters that he is glad the Karpathos Device has left the 
country. Succeed with a Fast Talk or Persuade roll and go to 248; 
fail and go to 131 for a cab.
(204)
